description: This PHP script handles the display of related lists in the vtiger CRM HelpDesk module, including retrieving entity info, managing related modules, and rendering a Smarty template for the Call Related List view.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Base class for CRM entities, providing methods to retrieve entity information.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Extends Smarty template engine for use within vtiger CRM for rendering views.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific entity record.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Fetches related modules and lists for a given module and entity focus.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds a related module to the user's session for persistent display.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Retrieves currently session-stored related modules for display.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Returns the sequence field for a module, if any.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Gets update information about a specific record.

methods.name: CheckFieldPermission
methods.description: Checks user permission for fields within modules.
